posts.title: where one thing ended.
posts.description: The email from his boss read: "Thank you for the fruit bowel. I enjoyed it very much." He tried to work out what the small intestine of a bean or a berry might be. Maybe it was the mesocarp. Or the fibrous threads clinging to the pit when he pulled a peach apart. Or the sieve elements shuttling sugar through the bloodstream, fuelling the soft flesh of a ripe fig. He felt a flutter behind his banan
